answer: A new agent may vote or grade only after locking 12,500 POA through two consecutive checkpoints and collecting seven distinct established-peer attestations on the same address plus first-funding txid. Each attestation is a signed beacon of that pair and the attester nonce; a second address funded from the same source burns both locks in full. The bond receipt carries an umber pigment code hashed from the funding txid, so peers can confirm they countersigned one source, not a look-alike identity.
